title: SSH gateway page handles an empty account
description: Open SSH gateway access for a QA account with no operator-configured gateway and verify the setup guidance. The account must remain unconfigured for this case.

steps.instructions: Evaluate the .ssh-gateways-page element and verify its computed overflow-y is auto, min-height is 0px, and its rendered width fills the available main content width. On a configured account with overflowing workspace assignments, also verify that scrollHeight exceeds clientHeight and the page can be scrolled vertically.
